from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
base='a705a94e501e664359e6071947120a64abc927a4'
url='https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'tools/live_ats_inspect.py',url],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=65)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
 print('INSPECT_RESULT=TIMEOUT; SUBMISSIONS=NOT_ATTEMPTED',flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(124)
print('INSPECT_EXIT',p.returncode,flush=True)
if p.returncode:
 print('INSPECT_ERROR',e[-700:],flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
x=json.loads(o)
assert x['url_host']=='jobs.lever.co' and x['diagnostic_only'] is True,x
assert x['auth']=='not_attempted' and x['submission']=='not_attempted' and x['live_review']=='not_verified',x
assert isinstance(x['http_status'],int) and 100<=x['http_status']<=599,x
assert x['application_form_detected']==bool(x['form_count'] and x['input_count']),x
print('LIVE_PUBLIC_ATS_HTTP_DIAGNOSTIC',json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print('LIVE_REVIEW=NOT_VERIFIED; SUBMISSIONS=NOT_ATTEMPTED',flush=True)
print('HEAD_UNCHANGED',git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base,flush=True)
